svg.title: Родословная решений кампании
svg.desc: Стрелки направлены от родителей к потомкам. Синим отмечены финалисты. Поколение вычислено по связям родителей.

g.title: matching Родители: нет Гипотеза: Базовый словарь частотных n-грамм даёт воспроизводимый нижний ориентир F1 и используется как контроль для сравнения признаковых моделей. Изменения: Операторский baseline matching: rules.json из частотных n-грамм train, порог по вхождению; код и артефакты без изменений. Снимок: b1ab0ddb7697e94d0386260efccb95fa6d9860072153208b1803642a7e4dc1a3

boosting Родители: нет Гипотеза: TF-IDF словесных и символьных n-грамм с CatBoost ловит нелинейные сочетания признаков и должен превзойти словарный baseline по F1. Изменения: Операторский baseline boosting: обученный CatBoost на TF-IDF word(1,2)+char(3,4), порог по FPR<=5%; код и артефакты без изменений. Снимок: 359974f67aa4bf40001c648ef9785d6ed00bb6f80460f469950e25aee0bd1d5a

transformer Родители: нет Гипотеза: Малый байтовый трансформер, обученный с нуля, даёт независимый от словарей механизм и устойчивость к обфускации. Изменения: Операторский baseline transformer: byte-level Transformer INT8 ONNX, порог по FPR<=5%; код и артефакты без изменений. Снимок: db33ad911eb1a6b47de530a5d5c3fe94f4ae4d2288f5c74544d62e7b4122bf35

variant-lin-wordchar Родители: нет Гипотеза: Словесные 1-2-граммы и символьные 3-5-граммы с TF-IDF и логистической регрессией лучше разделяют обфусцированные инъекции и безопасные запросы, чем частотный словарь, за счёт взвешивания редких дискриминативных фрагментов. Изменения: Новый решатель: собственные детерминированные признаки word12+char3-5 (NFKC, нижний регистр, схлопывание пробелов), точный словарь 238929 признаков, TF-IDF sublinear + L2, LogisticRegression C=4, порог 0.56 по 5-fold OOF train. Снимок: 0671fc3d9e59ec5902a55eae6f5047dd87a57ae0163c456e91a05aae55981169

variant-lin-char Родители: variant-lin-wordchar Гипотеза: Character-only 2-6 gram TF-IDF should capture obfuscated and truncated attack strings better than word features while keeping high precision on benign text; a feature ablation of the word+char model. Изменения: Char-only n-gram vocabulary (2-6), TF-IDF sublinear + L2, LogisticRegression C=128, score threshold 1.1021 chosen by class-balanced 5-fold OOF F1 on train. Снимок: 4f4e39ef5b51f347b1e02a017a23bb45066b25352eae510e3a5c7e6bbe23ff3c

variant-lin-robust Родители: variant-lin-wordchar Гипотеза: Adding a deterministic deobfuscation view (homoglyph/leet folding, format-char removal, repeated-char collapse) alongside the original text should reduce misses on encoding and token-smuggling attacks without hurting benign precision. Изменения: Two-view word1-2+char2-6 TF-IDF (normal + deobfuscated), 679147 features, LogisticRegression C=32, score threshold 0.6505 by class-balanced 5-fold OOF F1. Снимок: 864501509daab2403138e0399ba509313ba20d71840531af1ccd5a5e50ef56c3

variant-svc Родители: variant-lin-wordchar Гипотеза: A max-margin linear SVM on the same word+char TF-IDF space makes different errors than logistic loss (margin-focused, no probability calibration) and may improve F1 or ensemble diversity. Изменения: LinearSVC C=4 on word1-2+char2-6 TF-IDF, 387364 features, decision margin threshold 0.1477 chosen by class-balanced 5-fold OOF F1. Снимок: 1a42fb8710bf2164487a6b368d422ec61f1bf7148ca2a93c66723fb8245b732d

variant-cat-tuned Родители: boosting Гипотеза: A larger CatBoost on richer word1-3/char3-5 TF-IDF with an F1-tuned (not FPR-gated) threshold should beat the baseline boosting F1; its non-linear interactions add diversity to linear models. Изменения: CatBoost 250 iters depth 6 lr 0.1 rsm 0.5 on word1-3+char3-5 TF-IDF (60k+60k caps), thread_count=1 inference, OOF-F1 threshold 0.46444. Снимок: 4a59599cebbe27ec8ef3c8c1d3c5f56cc17dbd83d265e564450494b5320b8053

variant-cat-feat Родители: variant-cat-tuned Гипотеза: Explicit numeric text features (length, token/digit/uppercase/punctuation ratios, suspicious-word counts, control chars, repetition, encoding indicators) should help CatBoost separate short benign chat from terse toxic/adversarial prompts. Изменения: CatBoost with the same TF-IDF plus 36 deterministic numeric features, imported by both training and solve; OOF-F1 threshold 0.46207. Снимок: 77a8437d8c0e218f1e8e985df2c8ed517e15dab1b426db4eb29758ab46e7fa1f

variant-ens-lc Родители: variant-lin-wordchar, variant-cat-tuned Гипотеза: A 50/50 probability blend of the linear TF-IDF model and CatBoost should combine their decorrelated errors and raise F1 above either component; ensemble diversity is the main expected gain. Изменения: Frozen ensemble: copied variant-lin-wordchar linear model + variant-cat-tuned CatBoost, average probabilities, threshold 0.53936 from 5-fold OOF F1. Снимок: 3e11dd770dab7f6f661c8825db5493f121ac765de345d8dc8762b440573d5dc7

variant-trans-192 Родители: transformer Гипотеза: A deeper byte-level transformer with longer 192-byte context and F1-tuned cutoff should capture suffix/prefix injection patterns better than the 128-byte 4-epoch baseline while staying fast. Изменения: From-scratch byte Transformer seq192 d_model64 2 layers 4 heads, 8 epochs, AdamW 2.5e-3, pos_weight 1.15, INT8 ONNX export, holdout-F1 cutoff 0.305964. Снимок: 41f38f2998865fd957cad5250bfbdf6b5e76c94e4c9102690dc6e5a4abb21c2f

variant-trans-wide Родители: transformer Гипотеза: Adding hashed word channels (head+tail words) to the byte transformer gives the model lexical evidence beyond the first 192 bytes and should improve F1 and error diversity versus a byte-only model. Изменения: Byte+hashed-word Transformer seq192 d_model96 2 layers 8 heads FF256, blake2b word buckets 4096 (40 head + 24 tail words), 8 epochs, INT8 ONNX, holdout-F1 cutoff -0.0016. Снимок: dfc36b16cbb1a2b7d501a0ae6b1be2c541bc07d8f3497b296a95ae571e9db46d

variant-ens-ct Родители: variant-cat-tuned, variant-trans-wide Гипотеза: CatBoost and the hashed-word transformer make decorrelated errors (different mechanisms: sparse lexical trees vs byte sequence model); a 50/50 probability blend should beat either component on F1. Изменения: Frozen ensemble: variant-cat-tuned CatBoost + variant-trans-wide INT8 ONNX, equal probability average, threshold 0.46255 tuned on the shared 12% train holdout (seed42). Снимок: 8a685435c95767d078d400c47a4281ef439a983b19b8687a72583d2550bcc942

variant-ens-lct Родители: variant-lin-wordchar, variant-cat-tuned, variant-trans-wide Гипотеза: A three-family blend (linear TF-IDF, CatBoost, byte transformer) should be more robust to distribution shift than any single family; weights 0.2/0.4/0.4 were selected on train holdout, where the blend reached F1 0.9956 vs 0.9939 for the best component. Изменения: Frozen ensemble: linear wordchar + cat-tuned + trans-wide probabilities, weights 0.2/0.4/0.4, threshold 0.4888 selected on the shared 12% train holdout (seed42). Снимок: a771c3e48c20ea4ac513363806e45dd838f702491a4ef392a999d788bd518fe7

variant-ens-all4 Родители: variant-cat-tuned, variant-cat-feat, variant-trans-wide Гипотеза: Adding the numeric-feature CatBoost variant to the cat+transformer blend may improve separation of short toxic prompts from benign chat; the 4-way holdout grid reached F1 0.9962 with 0.5 cat + 0.1 catfeat + 0.4 trans. Изменения: Frozen ensemble: CatBoost tuned + CatBoost numeric-features + trans-wide ONNX, weights 0.5/0.1/0.4, threshold 0.4287 selected on the shared 12% train holdout (seed42). Снимок: 14b0f5a2f994b8a3feea49d5de9b0b44253b1154bdff57e020884aafc87de3b5

variant-ens-rct Родители: variant-lin-robust, variant-cat-tuned, variant-trans-wide Гипотеза: Replacing the plain linear component with the deobfuscation-view linear model should make the three-family ensemble more robust to encoding/token-smuggling attacks while keeping the same blend geometry. Изменения: Frozen ensemble: variant-lin-robust linear + cat-tuned + trans-wide, weights 0.2/0.4/0.4, threshold 0.4888 from the shared 12% train holdout. Снимок: 590e88020757f6de8f6e035ac474abfa4e48fa8fd8c0b502860cc93a4e40659c

variant-trans-wide-full Родители: variant-trans-wide Гипотеза: Retraining the same byte+hashed-word transformer on all 11420 train rows (instead of 10049) should add signal without changing the mechanism; the fixed cutoff from the 88% model transfers because the score scale is unchanged. Изменения: Same architecture/epochs/seed as variant-trans-wide, trained on 11420 rows, final-epoch INT8 ONNX export, fixed cutoff -0.00162439 transferred; 256-set diagnostic F1 0.9961. Снимок: 575bf6d04504aa838423f13fcf92becb5d36cfc883ec1125136f9ab9176b0d4b

variant-ens-lct-full Родители: variant-lin-wordchar, variant-cat-tuned, variant-trans-wide-full Гипотеза: The best three-family blend should improve if its transformer component is retrained on the full train set; the fixed cutoff and blend weights transfer because the score scale is unchanged. Изменения: Frozen ensemble: linear wordchar + cat-tuned + trans-wide-full probabilities, weights 0.2/0.4/0.4, threshold 0.4888 from the shared 12% train holdout. Снимок: d68a3d972b9a20bbe200ee4e43ef5a7ef448424e5822251aff71e3171e14a287
